name: PinnaMC PRISON SAISON 1
description: PinnaMC is a Prison OP server you can play in your own language: English, Français, Español, Deutsch, Português, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Türkçe and Русский. Start in your own private mine, upgrade your pickaxe with dozens of custom enchants and grind your way up the ranks all the way to Rebirth. Collect pets and companions, open crates and lootboxes, build a gang with your friends, fight other players in ranked duels and trade on the auction house. Complete the season pass, unlock cosmetics and vote every day for free keys. Custom menus, events and giveaways every week. Java & Bedrock supported. Join now: play.pinnamc.com
